_about: Shared rules from the brand team (Threads Growth Experiment Part II, Launch Strategy for AI Ambassadors, Script Library, skills hustle-threads-hypothesis and threads-hustle-adapter; snapshot 18-20 Nov 2026). Used in every report and plan.

hypothesis_types.H1: Strong Expert POV - a clear claim that can differ from common opinion
hypothesis_types.H2: Pattern Recognition - she recognises her own behaviour or his
hypothesis_types.H3: Cost of Inaction - framed as permission to leave, never fear or guilt

content_principles: Conversion Intent (a clear reason to tap the link)
avoid: long discussions with no conversion intent
content unrelated to the product funnel
outlier_rule: engagement = likes + replies + reposts + shares; multiple = post / median of the author's last 40 posts; ✅ 5x or more, 🟡 3-5x, ❌ below; reposts are the main reach signal

pain_clusters.name: Waiting for his text, chasing him
phrases: only feel okay when he texts
pain_clusters.angle: her worth and his effort, not 'you're too needy'

pain_clusters.name: Missing an ex, no contact
pain_clusters.angle: not going back is strength, not defeat

pain_clusters.name: Wants to break up after every fight
pain_clusters.angle: 'this isn't drama' - protect her from the label

pain_clusters.name: Can't leave, keeps going back
phrases: loyal to people who hurt me
pain_clusters.angle: describe the pattern without the word 'trauma bond'

pain_clusters.name: Settling for the bare minimum
phrases: always the one who tries harder
pain_clusters.angle: permission verdict: the minimum is the answer

pain_clusters.name: Childhood shapes who she picks
pain_clusters.angle: 'If you grew up...' form; no 'inner child' in the post

pain_clusters.name: He cheated, she stayed - glow-up
phrases: why did I stay so long
pain_clusters.angle: staying was the mistake, leaving is the win

pain_clusters.name: Faith and pain
pain_clusters.angle: God as protection and comfort, not 'prayer didn't work'

north_star: Attributed payers, not likes. Content = Strong POV + Problem Recognition + Product Relevance + Conversion Intent.

verdicts.✅ Core: topic from the persona's core list
verdicts.🧪 Test: from the test list or next to a core topic
verdicts.🔍 Gap: references cover it, we don't yet - the operator decides
verdicts.❌ Skip: on the don't list, outside relationships, or can't be said in the persona's voice

angle_checks.pablo: Can a man say this to her so that she comes out as the winner (not the one at fault)? Lecturing men = ❌.
angle_checks.adeline: Is there a 'him' and his action in the post? A post only about her calm with no 'him' is weak - reframe it.

research_rules: Research in English for every persona (also Pablo); only the finished post is translated.
References from the last ~12 months, priority to the last 3 months; the author's own post; it must not rest only on the author's personality.
Skip rage-bait, pseudo-diagnoses and posts that rest on terms (love bombing, codependency - such posts got only 8-52 likes in the reference accounts). A term is fine as a search seed, not as a post.
Pablo: reject references that rest on wordplay, rhyme or US-only realities (e.g. PRAYING / PREYING) - mark every reference 'translates ✅/❌'.
Reposts are the main reach signal: on hits reposts beat comments. Record 🔁 separately; also give the multiple for 💬 alone.
Median engagement below ~50 = medium confidence. Never guess numbers.
Reference row types: Clone (same text form), Same topic (same pain cluster), New mechanic (same insight, another form), Persona voice.
Prefer fresh references (≤3 months) and clones: they prove the mechanic doesn't depend on one author.
hook_rules: Goal of research = NEW hooks. For every reference write the hook formula (text form without the author's words) and mark 🆕 new or 📚 from the persona's library.
The library is for checking, not a template; use at most one 📚 option.
If the same hook form is already in 2+ of the persona's cards from the last month, say so and find another.
writing_rules: Length: match the reference; hard ceiling about 40 words and 3-4 short lines; a CTA may add 10-20 words. Never an explanatory paragraph.
Keep the reference's mechanic (shape and rhythm), never its words; a word-for-word translation is also a copy.

The reframe is the punchline, in plain everyday words: 'he only shows up after you pull away', never clinical labels (reassurance-seeking, love bombing, codependency, anxious attachment, trauma bond, inner child).
Make it obvious who is speaking: 'X: quote' reads as X saying it - use a verb ('all I heard was', 'was told').
Must read naturally out loud, as in a conversation.
No engagement bait, no generic open questions, no follow-me CTAs, no product pitch, no shame. Community questions are separate interactive posts.
H3 Cost of Inaction = permission to leave, never fear or blame.
cta_rules: Plan both kinds: posts WITH a CTA (to the quiz) and WITHOUT (made to be reposted to a friend or to him).

A CTA is earned: the post leaves an open 'why me?' / 'what now?', then bridge ('If that's you...', 'That fear has a source.') + personal payoff ('shows what's behind yours', 'which pattern keeps you stuck') + the quiz in bio.
Never a bare 'Quiz in bio.' / 'Link in bio.' Test: if the last line would fit under any post, rewrite it.
Never invent a quiz name or what it shows - write 'the quiz in my bio'. Default path: link in bio (Funnel A); a CTA in a self-reply or pinned post is a separate labelled test.
